title.narrative: Advancing the Decarbonization of Türkiye's Cement Industry

description.narrative: The project supports Türkiye in decarbonizing the cement sector by implementing two innovative pilot projects and promoting an enabling framework for decarbonization efforts. The objective is to catalyze transformational change in the cement industry by creating a business case for near-zero-emission production. The project will develop a suitable policy framework, project-specific decarbonization plans, replicable financial mechanisms, and implement pilot projects. These interventions will promote GHG mitigation and significantly contribute to Türkiye’s net-zero target by 2053 and its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC). The project will foster a climate-resilient and competitive industry, create green jobs, stimulate green investment, encourage the adoption of near-zero-emission technologies and innovation, and practice inclusive governance, technology, and investment partnerships.
